content: New aggregation repo for anyone running a personal weather station 👇

embeds.title: 🌦️ PWS Toolbox
embeds.description:
Every tool for turning a weather station in your garden into a website on the internet.

Hardware → collection software → database → skin/template → charts → hosting → the networks you upload to. Curated, categorised and link-checked.

fields.name: 📡 Hardware
fields.value: Ecowitt · Davis · Tempest · Ambient · Fine Offset · DIY sensors
